503:t_024:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「$$ヒイロ$$ has that resolve too! So does Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン#relena$$!」

503:t_024:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「You're just like $$シャア$$! Don't think you can bear your family's destiny and everything else alone!」

503:t_024:7.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Open your heart, $$リディ$$! Feel $$ヒイロ$$ and $$リリーナ$$'s determination!」

503:t_025:2.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I hear $$マリーメイア・クシュリナーダ$$ once said history dances an endless waltz to the three-beat rhythm of war, peace, and revolution...」

503:t_025:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「Then I'll... With you, me, and $$ガンダム$$ as our three beats, I'll fight until peace comes, however endless the road!」

503:t_026:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「$$リリーナ$$! I'm coming now!!」

503:t_027:0.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What will you do now, $$リディ$$? $$ヒイロ$$ just beat your trump card.」

503:t_027:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$ヒイロ$$ and $$リリーナ$$ fought without regard for their lives... Can you still claim that your resolve alone is special?」

503:t_028:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「His darkness runs even deeper than we imagined...」

503:t_028:2.en:
$$メリーベル$$
「Oh, well... We couldn't even defeat $c, and they took the Queen back too.」

503:t_028:3.en:
$$グエン$$
「Don't worry. His fight has only just begun.」

503:t_028:4.en:
$$グエン$$
「Let's withdraw too, before things get troublesome.」

503:t_028:5.en:
$$グエン$$
(I hope to see you again someday too, $$ローラ$$.)

503:t_028:6.en:
$$メラン$$
「Vice Foreign Minister $$ドーリアン#relena$$ has contacted us. She appears to have minor injuries, but she says she's safe.」

503:t_028:7.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I see... We won today because $$ヒイロ$$'s and her resolve surpassed Ensign $$リディ$$'s.」

503:t_028:8.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(You did well, $$リリーナ$$... Today's battle taught me something too.)

503:t_028:9.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(I'm no longer the one who will save you...)

503:t_029:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「We're facing a large force. I'll take them down efficiently so we can rescue $$リリーナ$$ as soon as possible!」

503:t_029:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(Wait for me, $$リリーナ$$. I'll be there soon...!)

503:t_100:0.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
($$リリーナ$$... I'll eliminate everyone who tries to use you.)

503:t_100:1.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(So follow the path you believe in.)

503:t_101:0.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(Wait for me, $$リリーナ$$. I will protect you.)

503:t_101:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
(That's the last duty of your foolish brother...!)

503:t_102:0.en:
$$ブライト$$
(Ensign $$リディ$$... Is this the result of seeing and hearing things for yourself and acting on your own judgment?)

503:t_102:1.en:
$$ブライト$$
(If so, we won't hesitate to fight you...! But if not, we'll stop you and drill a soldier's way of life into you again!)

503:t_103:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「We're facing that black $$ユニコーン$$! Everyone, stay focused!」

503:t_103:2.en:
$$レイアム$$
「But, Captain...! Ensign $$リディ$$ is aboard it...」

503:t_103:3.en:
$$オットー$$
「That's all the more reason! He's no ordinary pilot!」

503:t_103:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Besides, he won't die that easily! Don't hold back out of some misplaced concern!」

503:t_104:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「With this machine, even if I'm facing Captain $$アムロ$$...!」

503:t_104:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I never taught you to fight by relying on your machine, Ensign $$リディ$$!」

503:t_104:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「Right now, I have to win by any means necessary!」

503:t_104:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That isn't resolve at all! It's an obsession!」

503:t_104:4.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Wake up, $$リディ$$! Your gift didn't awaken so you could do this!」

503:t_105:0.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$カミーユ$$! Even you won't get any mercy if you stand in my way!」

503:t_105:1.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Is this how you intend to settle our rivalry!?」

503:t_105:2.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「You said you'd fight fair and take the ace pilot's spot on the $$ネェル・アーガマ$$!」

503:t_105:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「That's all in the past! I'm fighting as a member of $$クロノ$$ to protect the future!」

503:t_106:0.en:
$$エマ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! Has the $$マーセナス家$$ swallowed you up after all!?」

503:t_106:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Even if I didn't choose this path willingly, it's the only one I have now!」

503:t_106:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm coming through, Lieutenant $$エマ$$! I'm not the man I used to be!」

503:t_107:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Don't think you can stop me now, $$カツ$$!」

503:t_107:2.en:
$$カツ$$
「You should know I won't give in to threats like that!」

503:t_107:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then I'll shut you up by force!」

503:t_107:4.en:
$$カツ$$
「If you're not the man you used to be, neither am I! You'd better be ready!」

503:t_108:0.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「You've fallen pretty low, $$リディ$$.」

503:t_108:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「I won't make excuses! This is who I am now, Captain $$ナイジェル$$!」

503:t_108:2.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「What the hell do excuses have to do with a soldier!? As far as I'm concerned, you're a deserter who left his unit on his own!」

503:t_108:3.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Act like a soldier and report what you learned to your superiors! Don't think a greenhorn who can't even do that can take me on!」

503:t_109:0.en:
$$刹那$$
「Stop, Ensign $$リディ$$! Share the burden you're carrying with us!」

503:t_109:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「Stay out of people's hearts, $$イノベイター$$! $$クロノ$$ exists because of people like you!」

503:t_109:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「Forgive me, $$刹那$$! For the world's sake, your existence can't be allowed!」

503:t_110:0.en:
$$シン$$
「Please remember, Ensign $$リディ$$! We're comrades who've fought side by side!」

503:t_110:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$シン$$... If only you weren't a $$コーディネイター$$...」

503:t_110:2.en:
$$シン$$
「So $$クロノ$$ really won't accept the existence of $$コーディネイター$$s!」

503:t_110:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm not going to spout childish emotional arguments! But your existence can't be allowed!」

503:t_110:4.en:
$$シン$$
「I won't let you take $$コーディネイター$$ lives over some nonsensical reasoning like that!」

503:t_110:5.en:
$$シン$$
「Ensign! If you're coming at me by force, I'll take you on head-on!」

503:t_111:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「Ensign $$リディ$$! What happened to the man who fought for $$オードリー$$!?」

503:t_111:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「I'm fighting to save her too! If I get the Box and wipe out $$ネオ・ジオン$$, $$ミネバ$$ can live as an ordinary woman!」

503:t_111:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「...It's the only way! The only way!」

503:t_111:4.en:
$$キラ$$
「Your self-centered methods won't change anything, Ensign $$リディ$$! So please stop fighting!」

503:t_112:0.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「$$バンシィ$$...! Our roles are reversed this time!」

503:t_112:2.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「It isn't reacting to me, so you seem to have disabled its NT-D functions!」

503:t_112:3.en:
$$リディ$$
「I won't lose, even without that thing!」

503:t_112:4.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「Wake up! Will continuing this fight really bring about the future you want!?」

503:t_112:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「It will, if I defeat $$バナージ$$ and destroy $$ネオ・ジオン$$!」
